info.title: GroundCheck MCP
info.description: Fact verification for agents. verify_claim checks one claim against retrieved public sources and returns supported, refuted or unverified with sufficiency, an error bound and a signed provenance receipt. The other tools are paid per call and return a payment offer that this connection cannot settle. Unverified never means false.

post.description: Sends Model Context Protocol messages to the hosted GroundCheck server over Streamable HTTP. The agent runtime manages the session, so makers do not call this operation directly.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Media types the MCP server may return.
